  adaptation:
    rank        1, 2, 3, 4                         [tune adaptation]  how much capacity the adapter has to change behaviour
    lr          2e-05, 3.81111e-05, 7.26229e-05, 0.000138387 [tune adaptation]  how far each step moves the adapter
    steps       30, 60, 120, 240                   [default]  how long to train the adapter
  pretraining:
    lr          1e-06, 1.7302e-06, 2.9936e-06, 5.1795e-06 [tune adaptation]  how far each step moves the weights themselves
    steps       20, 36, 66, 120                    [default]  how much of the corpus to walk through
